settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Everything you need to know about shipping, returns, and our stores.

settings.question: Do you offer click and collect?
settings.answer: Yes we do! Just select the "Pickup" option at checkout when paying, and have your order number ready once you arrive at the warehouse to collect.

settings.question: What pick up locations do you have?
settings.answer: Pickup is available from our Melbourne based warehouse located at 4 Ardmillan Road, Moonee Ponds.

settings.question: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.answer: We aim to dispatch all orders from our warehouse ASAP. Usually once an order is placed on our website, it is sent out for delivery the following day. Delivery time varies based on location, but you can expect to receive your order between 1-2 business days after its been dispatched.

settings.question: Do you ship Australia Wide?
settings.answer: Currently we only ship within the state of Victoria, but we are however, more than happy for you to arrange your own transport to pick up and deliver your order if you live outside of VIC. Please contact us prior to purchasing so that we can facilitate this.

settings.question: How will my order get delivered?
settings.answer:
Your order will be delivered by one of two ways (whichever is cheaper).

1. Aramex Couriers - Your items will be picked up from our warehouse and delivered to your address by renowned Australian courier service Aramex.

2. In-house Delivery - Your items will be delivered straight from the warehouse in our company vans/trucks to your address.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping rates will vary depending on location and items/quantity ordered. We ship some items out for as low as $9.99 although most orders will fall between the $50-$100 range on average.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer:
Super Shelving will accept the return of a product if you change your mind or you are not satisfied within 14 days of purchase.

Please make contact with us within 14 calendar days from your purchase date if you would like to organise a return or exchange.

Your order must be in its original condition. Any wear or damage to your order will not qualify for a return. For a change of mind (return) you will need to send your order back to us. We will refund your money in full and we will only deduct the initial postage and handling cost we incurred when we sent your order to you. For an exchange of size or style you will need to pay for postage both ways and any price difference (if any).

settings.question: How do I initiate a return?
settings.answer: You can initiate a return by heading to our Contact Us page and sending us a message. Alternatively you can email us directly at Edwin_10@live.com.au

settings.question: What if my order arrives faulty/damaged?
settings.answer: Whilst we hope this never happens, if you do receive a damaged item or there is a manufacturing fault, please send us a message via our Contact Us page or email us directly at Edwin_10@live.com.au along with any descriptions and photos of the item/s damaged.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer:
We accept various payment methods. You can pay using a Credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Union Pay, Google Pay and Shop Pay.

If you would like to pay with a Bank Transfer, PayID or Cash please contact us via email to arrange this.

settings.question: Do you offer assembly/installation?
settings.answer: We do not currently offer installation, but it is very simple and easy to do yourself. All items will come with a clear instructions manual, and you can also view our assembly videos on our Assembly Instructions page.

settings.question: Is there warranty on your products?
settings.answer:
All Super Shelving products come with a 12-month standard warranty from the date of purchase. This warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal usage conditions.

What the warranty covers:
- Manufacturing defects: faults in materials or workmanship.
- Structural integrity: issues affecting the performance of shelves, beams, and uprights under recommended loading conditions.
- Parts replacement: repair or replacement of defective components at no additional cost.

The warranty does not cover:
- Damage caused by misuse, improper assembly, or overloading.
- General wear and tear, scratches, or cosmetic damages.
- Modifications or repairs performed by unauthorized personnel.
- Environmental factors such as moisture, rust, or corrosion resulting from improper storage or use.

To make a warranty claim:
1. Contact us via email at Edwin_10@live.com.au or call our customer service team at +61 431 533 520.
2. Provide proof of purchase (invoice or receipt) and details of the issue, including photos or videos if possible.
3. Our team will assess your claim and determine whether the issue is covered under warranty.

If approved, Super Shelving will repair or replace the defective product or component at no cost.

settings.question: Do you have a showroom?
settings.answer: Yes, you can view all of our products on display at our Moonee Ponds warehouse.
